" alt="Mara avatar" /><div><div class="avatar-msg" id="avatarMsg">I’ll guide you through the repair. Use “Speak” if you want me to read the current tip aloud.</div><div class="avatar-controls"><button class="btn" id="speakBtn">🔊 Speak</button><button class="btn ghost" id="tipBtn">New tip</button></div></div></div></div></div>

<script>
const screens=[...document.querySelectorAll('.screen')];let historyStack=['home'];
const state={containment:50,readiness:70,ems:45,critical:0,selected:{},audit:null,completed:{}};
const tips={home:'This game rewards balanced control. Maximum shutdown is not automatically the best environmental decision.',how:'Remember: worker PPE and environmental containment solve different parts of the risk.',briefing:'Look for pathways: air, doors, drains, traffic, cleaning methods and waste.',mission1:'Build the smallest effective controlled zone, not the biggest possible shutdown.',mission2:'Capture dust at the tool before it becomes a room-wide housekeeping problem.',mission3:'A failed control is a trigger to pause the source, not to export the dust outdoors.',mission4:'Cleanup can create more dust than the task if you use compressed air or dry sweeping.',mission5:'Reopening requires evidence that controls worked and deviations were addressed.',knowledge:'Terminology matters: composite particulate is a mixed material stream, not one single substance.',theory5:'A transparent deviation record is evidence of control and learning — not something to hide.',results:'A strong result combines containment, operational proportionality and documented control.'};
function clamp(v){return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,v))}
function go(id,push=true){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;screens.forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));el.classList.add('active');window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});if(push&&historyStack.at(-1)!==id)historyStack.push(id);updateBack();setTip(id);refreshScorecards();}
function updateBack(){document.getElementById('backBtn').disabled=historyStack.length<=1}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>go(b.dataset.go)));
document.getElementById('backBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(historyStack.length>1){historyStack.pop();go(historyStack.at(-1),false)}});
function scoreHTML(){return `<h3 style="margin-bottom:6px">Live performance</h3>${metric('Containment',state.containment)}${metric('Mission Readiness',state.readiness)}${metric('EMS Control',state.ems)}`}
function metric(name,val){return `<div class="metric"><label>${name}</label><div class="bar"><div class="fill" style="width:${val}%"></div></div><b>${val}</b></div>`}
function refreshScorecards(){['scorecard1','scorecard2','scorecard3','scorecard4'].forEach(id=>{const e=document.getElementById(id);if(e)e.innerHTML=scoreHTML()})}
function choose(stage,opt,btn){document.querySelectorAll(`[data-stage="${stage}"] .choice`).forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));btn.classList.add('selected');state.selected[stage]=opt}
document.querySelectorAll('.choice[data-option]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>choose(btn.closest('.choice-set').dataset.stage,btn.dataset.option,btn)));
const outcomes={
 '1A':{c:8,r:-22,e:0,ok:false,msg:'You created major disruption without addressing the actual particulate pathways. Warning tape is not a containment system.'},
 '1B':{c:22,r:8,e:14,ok:true,msg:'Correct. A defined local bay, controlled entry/exit and drain protection target the real environmental pathways while preserving the rest of the hangar.'},
 '1C':{c:-20,r:9,e:-18,crit:1,ok:false,msg:'PPE can protect the technician, but the work zone remains open. Dust can migrate to traffic routes, exits and drainage.'},
 '2A':{c:-16,r:4,e:-10,crit:1,ok:false,msg:'General ventilation dilutes room air after particles have already escaped the tool. It is not equivalent to capturing the dust at source.'},
 '2B':{c:24,r:6,e:12,ok:true,msg:'Correct. Source capture with shrouded tooling and suitable high-efficiency extraction is the strongest option in this set.'},
 '2C':{c:-24,r:8,e:-15,crit:1,ok:false,msg:'Compressed air resuspends deposited particulate and can distribute it far beyond the repair patch.'},
 '3A':{c:-26,r:6,e:-18,crit:1,ok:false,msg:'Continuing after loss of suction turns a known control failure into deliberate uncontrolled generation.'},
 '3B':{c:20,r:-3,e:18,ok:true,msg:'Correct. Stop generation, preserve the boundary, restore the control and then resume. This is a short, controlled operational interruption.'},
 '3C':{c:-32,r:4,e:-20,crit:1,ok:false,msg:'Opening the hangar exports the particulate pathway outdoors. Clearing indoor air is not environmental containment.'},
 '4A':{c:-24,r:6,e:-14,crit:1,ok:false,msg:'Dry sweeping and compressed air can re-aerosolise fine residues, creating secondary spread after the repair is technically complete.'},
 '4B':{c:22,r:5,e:18,ok:true,msg:'Correct. Controlled vacuuming / appropriate wet wiping plus sealed, traceable residue collection closes the containment chain.'},
 '4C':{c:-28,r:5,e:-20,crit:1,ok:false,msg:'Hosing the floor toward a drain transfers the particulate to another environmental pathway rather than containing it.'}
};
function evaluate(stage,next){const opt=state.selected[stage],fb=document.getElementById('fb'+stage);if(!opt){fb.className='feedback show ko';fb.innerHTML='<h4>Select an option first</h4><p>The simulator needs a procedural decision before it can evaluate the stage.</p>';return}if(state.completed[stage]){fb.className='feedback show';fb.innerHTML='<h4>Stage already evaluated</h4><p>Your score is locked for this stage. Continue to the learning checkpoint.</p><button class="btn primary" style="margin-top:12px" onclick="go(\''+next+'\')">Continue</button>';return}const o=outcomes[opt];state.containment=clamp(state.containment+o.c);state.readiness=clamp(state.readiness+o.r);state.ems=clamp(state.ems+o.e);state.critical+=o.crit||0;state.completed[stage]=true;fb.className='feedback show '+(o.ok?'ok':'ko');fb.innerHTML=`<h4>${o.ok?'Control accepted':'Control weakness detected'}</h4><p>${o.msg}</p><button class="btn primary" style="margin-top:12px" onclick="go('${next}')">Continue to theory</button>`;const scene=document.getElementById('scene'+stage);if(scene){scene.classList.remove('scene-ok','scene-bad');scene.classList.add(o.ok?'scene-ok':'scene-bad');const badge=scene.querySelector('.scene-badge');if(badge){badge.textContent=o.ok?'✓ CONTROL VERIFIED':'⚠ CONTROL WEAKNESS'}}refreshScorecards()}
document.getElementById('eval1').addEventListener('click',()=>evaluate('1','theory1'));document.getElementById('eval2').addEventListener('click',()=>evaluate('2','theory2'));document.getElementById('eval3').addEventListener('click',()=>evaluate('3','theory3'));document.getElementById('eval4').addEventListener('click',()=>evaluate('4','theory4'));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-audit]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-audit]').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('success'));b.classList.add('success');state.audit=b.dataset.audit;const fb=document.getElementById('fb5');fb.className='feedback show '+(state.audit==='B'?'ok':'ko');const text={A:'A visual glance alone does not provide a disciplined release check or documented close-out.',B:'Correct. The release decision combines physical verification, waste control, deviation recording and evidence that the failed extraction control was restored.',C:'Proportionality matters. Extensive sampling is not automatically required when there is no evidence of off-site release; follow risk-based site procedures.',D:'Never erase a control deviation to protect the audit record. The value of an EMS is learning from what actually happened.'}[state.audit];fb.innerHTML='<h4>'+(state.audit==='B'?'Release package accepted':'Release package incomplete')+'</h4><p>'+text+'</p>';document.getElementById('finishBtn').disabled=false}));
document.getElementById('finishBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!state.completed['5']){if(state.audit==='B'){state.ems=clamp(state.ems+18);state.containment=clamp(state.containment+8)}else if(state.audit==='C'){state.readiness=clamp(state.readiness-15);state.ems=clamp(state.ems+2)}else{state.ems=clamp(state.ems-22);if(state.audit==='D')state.critical++}state.completed['5']=true}go('theory5')});document.getElementById('finalizeBtn').addEventListener('click',showResults);
function showResults(){const avg=Math.round((state.containment+state.readiness+state.ems)/3);document.getElementById('finalScore').textContent=avg;let rank='Control Recovery Required',msg='Your decisions left significant weaknesses in the containment chain. Review the learning checkpoints before repeating the operation.';if(avg>=85&&state.critical===0){rank='Composite Guardian · Gold';msg='Excellent. You protected environmental pathways, preserved operational proportionality and maintained a defensible EMS record.'}else if(avg>=70&&state.critical<=1){rank='Composite Guardian · Silver';msg='Strong overall performance. One or two decisions could be tightened, but the control chain is largely robust.'}else if(avg>=55){
